item.title: Jones’ double-double helps Lancers fend off Manteca
item.description: Coming off back-to-back losses for the first time all season, East Union was in no position to look past a struggling, yet dangerous, intra-city rival Wednesday at Dalben Center. The Lancers never trailed but had trouble putting away a pesky Manteca team in search of its first Valley Oak League win. Thanks to another double-double effort from Lorenzo Jones, timely defensive stops and clutch free-throw shooting, East Union prevailed, 57-50.

item.title: Neighborhood parks will close at sundown
item.description: Manteca’s neighborhood parks — including greenbelts such as the Tidewater Bikeway — will all be closing uniformly from dusk to dawn.

item.title: Manteca Transit will add $3 all-day pass for riders under 65
item.description: Manteca Transit will be adding a $3 all-day pass to ride buses on its four fixed routes. The City Council approved the move on Tuesday.
